slug: 2019-10-03 South Africa must harness technology in a way that helps fix its problems

facts.fact: Alison Gillwald (The Conversation) wrote on 2019-10-03 that various government departments had developed policies in their sectoral silos but there was no overarching digital policy to coordinate the state and the public and private sectors; the document's own date is used, as the article gives none for the observation.
